scope: Correct actual Google issuer callback compatibility and observe existing incremental Gmail send grant without enabling operational authority.
riskAnalysis: STRICT OAuth parameter and token-scope parsing. Exact issuer, duplicate rejection, source/runtime/state and encrypted-unconfirmed controls retained; no additional consent scope requested.

threatModel.assets: Google code, encrypted access/refresh tokens, immutable subject identity, existing Gmail Inbox and owner scope.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner session to fixed callback state; provider responses to encrypted unconfirmed Redis records; cleanup versus newer reconnect.
threatModel.abuseCases: State replay, foreign workspace, stale deployment, subject substitution, enlarged scopes, lost storage acknowledgement, stalled owner checks and forged recovery.
threatModel.mitigations: Existing owner policy; exact runtime/deployment/source/release/subject/scopes; atomic consume/CAS audit; bounded callback and exact compensation; no operational activation or credential broker.

rollback: Locally revoke exact Workspace preparation record, then revert only this Preview consent extension. Preserve existing Gmail, Vercel/GitHub receipts, financial records and historical failures.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Bound fixed Google JSON sizes; token identity/scopes validated; no raw provider errors or credentials returned.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact runtime source/deployment/release plus one-use state and exact operation/revision recovery.
negativePaths.concurrency: Concurrent callback consumes once; exact late-store compensation cannot clobber newer reconnect.
negativePaths.cancellation: Whole callback timeout and separately bounded cleanup; unconfirmed record always unusable, no physical Redis cancellation claim.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No agent worker or provider model is started; existing worker lifecycle safeguards remain unchanged.
negativePaths.api-outage: Storage outages explicitly preserve cleanup uncertainty; no automatic retry or shared-client provider revocation.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Existing fresh owner policy plus same-origin API guards; denied owner cannot exchange, recover or read foreign records.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No paid model request, spending approval, browser session, service purchase or financial mutation.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Lost final-store acknowledgement compensated against exact record; outage may retain encrypted but permanently unconfirmed credentials.

defects.rootCause: Actual Google authorization response includes issuer field omitted from both callback allowlists; existing incremental Gmail send token scope also absent.
defects.detectionGap: Existing synthetic fixtures omitted real issuer parameter and existing Gmail send scope combination.
defects.regression: Real-shaped callback issuer and combined incremental scopes, foreign/nonscalar/rawduplicate issuer rejection and unchanged outgoing scopes/unconfirmed flags.
defects.historicalPrevention: Record sanitized real response shape and retain negative issuer and scope contract tests; never preserve OAuth state or code.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing session/owner policy and Redis compare-and-audit; distinct callback prefix preserves Gmail.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Google CallerCore Admin client, registered stable callback, Preview encryption; no Work token transfer.
proactiveReview.threats: Replay, forged scopes/identity/recovery, cross-workspace substitution, stale source/deployment and late writes.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Bounded callback and cleanup; ciphertext may remain unconfirmed after outages, never agent authority.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Owner/storage/exchange stalls, lost final CAS acknowledgement, newer reconnect and revocation schedules.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA actual-diff review plus 29 focused adversarial tests passed; Auditor actual-source review approved exact issuer/legacy scope boundary conditional on remote verification.
proactiveReview.recovery: Exact current operation hash/revision owner recovery or local revoke; shared Google grant untouched.
proactiveReview.readiness: Preparation only until full STRICT/Redis/CI/CodeQL/exact Preview UI verified; real consent requires owner and agent tools remain disabled.
